correctness.rationale: For all n>=6, reflection length is n-c(pi); the central Jucys polynomial acts on irrep lambda with coefficient sum E_lambda(p)=sum_{r>=1}a_r r^p. At hook (n-2,1,1), the signed Laplace integral of (1-z)(1-2z)prod_{j=1}^{n-3}(1+jz) has one negative interval 0<t<log2 and one positive interval t>log2. Weight t^{-1-p} strictly tilts their ratio; F_m(0)=-1 and F_m(1)=(m+1)! yield the unique beta_n in (0,1). Multiplying the integrand by (1+(m+1)e^{-t}) shifts the root strictly lower; the stated explicit integral bounds establish beta_n<100/m! for m>=50. At n=6 the exact rational checker bounds the root and checks all ten nontrivial irreducible branches; f^(4,1,1)=10 gives nullity 100 and centered rank 619. Independently reconstructed the 11 S6 content polynomials/eigensigns and numerical root ~0.1541377738, separate from the exact Fraction certificate. No exact wp_n asserted for n>=7.
residual_risks: Exact rational certificate relies on the inspected check.py interval tail inequalities; separate check is high-precision spectral comparison, not a second independent exact endpoint certificate.
